notes: Frontend coverage car: every configuration the product accepts is now reachable from the console, and every new path is proved end to end. A full audit of the settings schema, the secrets.env slot inventory and the 30 capability documents produced a coverage matrix (docs/features/frontend_coverage.md) showing 41 settings leaf keys with no control, five whole partitions (usage, evolution, 9-route channels, event hooks, web3) with no editor, and 20 runtime credential slots with no in-product path at all - all now closed. New GET/POST /api/secrets behind the Bearer WEB_TOKEN write gate: 32 editable slots (model, Telegram, gateway, three CEX venues, 15 channel slots, media BYOK, connectors) plus WEB_TOKEN presence-only with a rotate-by-hand hint; the response ever only carries slot name, group, set flag and - with a valid token - length, never a value, in any response, log line or error; writes are atomic own-line rewrites of secrets.env at mode 0600 and idempotent. The console gains a credential slot editor grouped by area (values live only in the password field and are cleared immediately after a successful set), a 9-route channels form with per-route status and a send-test button, an event hooks editor (one argv element per line, honest server-side validation surfaced verbatim), usage metrics/pricing/log controls, mycore context_dirs/upstreams/mcp/shell controls plus a 25-tool kill-switch checkbox grid and an env-override chip, an evolution schedule editor with a live cross-check against the served schedule, and editable web3 auto-approval caps next to the read-only summary chips. GET /api/capabilities adds env_overrides (names only) and mycore.known_tools; new GET /api/cron renders the job list read-only on the Overview system card alongside thirteen capability rows. MYCORE_WD_CHAT no longer no-ops when the wizard wrote it into secrets.env but the runtime only read the process environment: mycore/envslots.py resolves env first, then the own-line slot, then an honest empty. secrets.env.example now documents all 22 previously undocumented runtime slots. Evidence: tmp/e2e_frontend_coverage.py (62 legs, isolated profile: set/clear roundtrip with a zero-echo sweep over every payload, 401/400 matrix, settings writes verified through capability/tool/channel/schedule behavior changes, channel send 409 semantics, env-override names, cron seeding, wd-chat three-state) and tmp/e2e_frontend_ui.js (33 Playwright legs: form saves round-tripped through the server, credential values scanned out of the entire DOM, zh locale parity, zero page errors), production secrets.env and console byte-compared untouched. Suites after this car: core 1168/1168, console smoke 197/197, router 30/30, memory 58/58, setup 99/99, profile isolation 63/63, desktop shell 15/15, source lint 0 issues over 66 files, doctor 0F/0W, publish gate READY(0), console screenshot gate 7/7 js-clean, site gate ALL PASS (43 assertions); real-machine E2E: 18/18, 8/8, 44/44, 35/35, web3 read-only 33/33, web3 approval 61/61, frontend coverage 62/62, frontend UI 33/33. Locale packs: console 480 keys (en/zh parity), site pack 165 keys.
